intro: Assault on Fenris Isle is the climactic military directive issued by High Executor Hadrec to eradicate the Scourge stronghold in Silverpine Forest. To break the Lich King's grip upon Lake Lordamere, Forsaken agents are sent to storm Fenris Keep and take the head of the necromancer Thule Ravenclaw.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.
You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw. I want his head!
This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, friend. You must not fail.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Scourge cannot be allowed to remain in Silverpine, friend. Come back to me when you have proof of Thule's death.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The death of Thule Ravenclaw was no small event, friend. Renferrel tells me that the energies released when you destroyed Thule were felt even as far as the Sepulcher.
Your actions ring through the ranks of the Forsaken. Your value to us grows.
